en: A long time ago, in the heart of the North Pole, Santa Claus and his elves were busy preparing
zh: 很久以前，在北極的中心，聖誕老人和他的精靈們正忙著準備
ja: ずっと昔、北極の中心で、サンタクロースと彼のエルフたちは忙しく準備をしていました
local: A long time ago, in the heart of the North Pole, Santa Claus and his elves were busy preparing
ja_pron: Zutto mukashi, hokkyoku no chūshin de, Santa Claus to kare no erufu-tachi wa isogashiku junbi o shite imashita
native: A long time ago, in the heart of the North Pole, Santa Claus and his elves were busy preparing

en: for Christmas.
zh: 為聖誕節做準備。
ja: クリスマスのために。
local: for Christmas.
ja_pron: Kurisumasu no tame ni.
native: for Christmas.

en: Back then, Santa didn't have flying reindeer.
zh: 那時候，聖誕老人還沒有會飛的馴鹿。
ja: 当時、サンタには飛ぶトナカイはいませんでした。
local: Back then, Santa didn't have flying reindeer.
ja_pron: Tōji, Santa ni wa tobu tonakai wa imasen deshita.
native: Back then, Santa didn't have flying reindeer.

en: He delivered gifts on foot with a magical sack.
zh: 他用一個魔法袋徒步送禮物。
ja: 彼は魔法の袋を持って徒歩でプレゼントを配っていました。
local: He delivered gifts on foot with a magical sack.
ja_pron: Kare wa mahō no fukuro o motte toho de purezento o kubatte imashita.
native: He delivered gifts on foot with a magical sack.

en: As more children started celebrating Christmas, Santa realized he needed help to deliver
zh: 隨著越來越多的孩子開始慶祝聖誕節，聖誕老人意識到他需要幫助來送達
ja: より多くの子供たちがクリスマスを祝うようになると、サンタは配達の手助けが必要だと気づきました。
local: As more children started celebrating Christmas, Santa realized he needed help to deliver
ja_pron: Yori ōku no kodomotachi ga Kurisumasu o iwau yō ni naru to, Santa wa haitatsu no tedasuke ga hitsuyō da to kizukimashita.
native: As more children started celebrating Christmas, Santa realized he needed help to deliver

en: presents to all the children in one night.
zh: 禮物給所有的孩子們在一夜之間。
ja: 一晩で全ての子供たちにプレゼントを届けるために。
local: presents to all the children in one night.
ja_pron: Hitoban de subete no kodomotachi ni purezento o todokeru tame ni.
native: presents to all the children in one night.

en: That's when the story of the reindeer began.
zh: 那時馴鹿的故事開始了。
ja: そこでトナカイの物語が始まりました。
local: That's when the story of the reindeer began.
ja_pron: Soko de tonakai no monogatari ga hajimarimashita.
native: That's when the story of the reindeer began.

en: One snowy winter evening, Santa was walking through the forest when he stumbled upon
zh: 一個下雪的冬夜，聖誕老人走在森林中，偶然發現了
ja: ある雪の降る冬の夜、サンタは森を歩いているときに偶然見つけました。
local: One snowy winter evening, Santa was walking through the forest when he stumbled upon
ja_pron: Aru yuki no furu fuyu no yoru, Santa wa mori o aruite iru toki ni guuzen mitsukemashita.
native: One snowy winter evening, Santa was walking through the forest when he stumbled upon

en: a group of reindeer huddled together under a sparkling aurora.
zh: 一群聚集在閃爍極光下的馴鹿。
ja: 輝くオーロラの下に集まったトナカイの群れを。
local: a group of reindeer huddled together under a sparkling aurora.
ja_pron: Kagayaku ōrora no shita ni atsumatta tonakai no mure o.
native: a group of reindeer huddled together under a sparkling aurora.

en: These were no ordinary reindeer.
zh: 這些不是普通的馴鹿。
ja: それらは普通のトナカイではありませんでした。
local: These were no ordinary reindeer.
ja_pron: Sorera wa futsū no tonakai de wa arimasen deshita.
native: These were no ordinary reindeer.

en: They had shimmering antlers that glowed faintly in the dark and hooves that left a trail
zh: 牠們有在黑暗中微微發光的閃爍鹿角和留下星塵足跡的蹄。
ja: 彼らは暗闇でかすかに光る輝く角と、星屑の跡を残す蹄を持っていました。
local: They had shimmering antlers that glowed faintly in the dark and hooves that left a trail
ja_pron: Karera wa kurayami de kasuka ni hikaru kagayaku tsuno to, hoshikuzu no ato o nokosu hiza o motte imashita.
native: They had shimmering antlers that glowed faintly in the dark and hooves that left a trail

en: of stardust.
zh: 留下星塵的足跡。
ja: 星屑の跡を。
local: of stardust.
ja_pron: Hoshikuzu no ato o.
native: of stardust.

en: The leader of the group, a proud and swift reindeer named Dasher, stepped forward.
zh: 這群的領袖，是一隻驕傲且迅速的馴鹿，名叫達舍爾，牠走了出來。
ja: グループのリーダーである誇り高く素早いトナカイ、ダッシャーが前に出ました。
local: The leader of the group, a proud and swift reindeer named Dasher, stepped forward.
ja_pron: Gurūpu no rīdā de aru hokori takaku subayai tonakai, Dasshā ga mae ni demashita.
native: The leader of the group, a proud and swift reindeer named Dasher, stepped forward.

en: He explained that they were part of a magical herd, born from the light of the northern
zh: 他解釋說牠們是魔法群體的一部分，誕生於北方光芒之中，
ja: 彼は彼らが魔法の群れの一部であり、北の光から生まれたと説明しました。
local: He explained that they were part of a magical herd, born from the light of the northern
ja_pron: Kare wa karera ga mahō no mure no ichibu de ari, kita no hikari kara umareta to setsumei shimashita.
native: He explained that they were part of a magical herd, born from the light of the northern

en: skies.
zh: 天空。
ja: 空です。
local: skies.
ja_pron: Sora desu.
native: skies.

en: Each of them had been gifted with a special talent, and they had been waiting for someone
zh: 牠們每一隻都被賦予了特別的才能，並且一直在等待一個
ja: それぞれが特別な才能を授かっており、純粋な心を持つ誰かを待っていました。
local: Each of them had been gifted with a special talent, and they had been waiting for someone
ja_pron: Sorezore ga tokubetsu na sainō o sazukatte ori, junsui na kokoro o motsu dareka o matte imashita.
native: Each of them had been gifted with a special talent, and they had been waiting for someone

en: with a pure heart to guide them.
zh: 擁有純潔心靈的人來引導牠們。
ja: 純粋な心を持つ人に導かれるのを。
local: with a pure heart to guide them.
ja_pron: Junsui na kokoro o motsu hito ni michibikareru no o.
native: with a pure heart to guide them.

en: Santa smiled and said, would you help me bring joy to children around the world?
zh: 聖誕老人微笑著說，你願意幫我帶給全世界的孩子們歡樂嗎？
ja: サンタは微笑みながら言いました、「世界中の子供たちに喜びを届けるのを手伝ってくれますか？」
local: Santa smiled and said, would you help me bring joy to children around the world?
ja_pron: Santa wa hohoemi nagara iimashita, `Sekaijū no kodomotachi ni yorokobi o todokeru no o tetsudatte kuremasu ka?'
native: Santa smiled and said, would you help me bring joy to children around the world?

en: The reindeer eagerly agreed, and so the team was formed.
zh: 馴鹿們熱切地同意了，於是隊伍成立了。
ja: トナカイたちは快く同意し、こうしてチームが結成されました。
local: The reindeer eagerly agreed, and so the team was formed.
ja_pron: Tonakai-tachi wa kokoroyoku dōi shi, kōshite chīmu ga kessei saremashita.
native: The reindeer eagerly agreed, and so the team was formed.

en: The original team consisted of eight reindeer, each chosen for their unique abilities.
zh: 原始隊伍由八隻馴鹿組成，每隻都因其獨特能力被選中。
ja: 元のチームは8頭のトナカイで構成され、それぞれが独自の能力で選ばれました。
local: The original team consisted of eight reindeer, each chosen for their unique abilities.
ja_pron: Moto no chīmu wa 8-tō no tonakai de kōsei sare, sorezore ga dokuji no nōryoku de erabaremashita.
native: The original team consisted of eight reindeer, each chosen for their unique abilities.

en: One, Dasher, known for his speed, Dasher is the fastest of the reindeer, and leads the
zh: 第一，達舍爾，以速度聞名，達舍爾是馴鹿中最快的，並領導著
ja: 一番目はダッシャー、速さで知られ、トナカイの中で最も速く、
local: One, Dasher, known for his speed, Dasher is the fastest of the reindeer, and leads the
ja_pron: Ichiban-me wa Dasshā, hayasa de shirare, tonakai no naka de mottomo hayaku,
native: One, Dasher, known for his speed, Dasher is the fastest of the reindeer, and leads the

en: charge during takeoff.
zh: 起飛時的衝鋒。
ja: 離陸時の先頭を務めます。
local: charge during takeoff.
ja_pron: Ririku-ji no sentō o tsutomemasu.
native: charge during takeoff.

en: Second, Dasher, graceful in light on her hooves.
zh: 第二，達舍爾，輕盈優雅地踏著蹄。
ja: 二番目はダッシャー、蹄の上で軽やかで優雅です。
local: Second, Dasher, graceful in light on her hooves.
ja_pron: Niban-me wa Dasshā, hizume no ue de karoyaka de yūga desu.
native: Second, Dasher, graceful in light on her hooves.

en: Dasher helps keep the sleigh balanced during tricky flights.
zh: 達舍爾幫助雪橇在困難的飛行中保持平衡。
ja: ダッシャーは難しい飛行中にそりのバランスを保つのを助けます。
local: Dasher helps keep the sleigh balanced during tricky flights.
ja_pron: Dasshā wa muzukashii hikō-chū ni sori no baransu o tamotsu no o tasukemasu.
native: Dasher helps keep the sleigh balanced during tricky flights.

en: Third, Prancer, always cheerful and energetic.
zh: 第三，普蘭瑟，總是開朗且充滿活力。
ja: 三番目はプランサー、いつも陽気で元気です。
local: Third, Prancer, always cheerful and energetic.
ja_pron: Sanban-me wa Puransā, itsumo yōki de genki desu.
native: Third, Prancer, always cheerful and energetic.

en: Prancer boosts the team's spirits, even on the longest nights.
zh: 普蘭瑟提升團隊的士氣，即使在最長的夜晚。
ja: プランサーは最も長い夜でもチームの士気を高めます。
local: Prancer boosts the team's spirits, even on the longest nights.
ja_pron: Puransā wa mottomo nagai yoru demo chīmu no shiki o takamemasu.
native: Prancer boosts the team's spirits, even on the longest nights.

en: Four, Vixen, clever and resourceful.
zh: 第四，維克森，聰明且足智多謀。
ja: 四番目はヴィクセン、賢くて機転が利きます。
local: Four, Vixen, clever and resourceful.
ja_pron: Yonban-me wa Vikusen, kashikokute kiten ga kikimasu.
native: Four, Vixen, clever and resourceful.

en: Vixen uses her wit to navigate the skies and solve any problems on the journey.
zh: 維克森用她的智慧導航天空，解決旅途中任何問題。
ja: ヴィクセンは機知を使って空を航行し、旅の途中の問題を解決します。
local: Vixen uses her wit to navigate the skies and solve any problems on the journey.
ja_pron: Vikusen wa kichi o tsukatte sora o kōkō shi, tabi no tochū no mondai o kaiketsu shimasu.
native: Vixen uses her wit to navigate the skies and solve any problems on the journey.

en: Five, comet, the strongest reindeer, comet can pull the sleigh through the roughest weather.
zh: 第五，彗星，最強壯的馴鹿，彗星能拉著雪橇穿越最惡劣的天氣。
ja: 五番目はコメット、最も強いトナカイで、荒天の中でもそりを引くことができます。
local: Five, comet, the strongest reindeer, comet can pull the sleigh through the roughest weather.
ja_pron: Goban-me wa Kometto, mottomo tsuyoi tonakai de, araten no naka demo sori o hiku koto ga dekimasu.
native: Five, comet, the strongest reindeer, comet can pull the sleigh through the roughest weather.

en: Six, Cupid, with a warm and loving heart, Cupid spreads kindness and joy wherever they fly.
zh: 第六，丘比特，擁有溫暖和充滿愛的心，丘比特在飛行的地方傳播善意和歡樂。
ja: 六番目はキューピッド、温かく愛情深い心を持ち、飛ぶ先々で親切と喜びを広めます。
local: Six, Cupid, with a warm and loving heart, Cupid spreads kindness and joy wherever they fly.
ja_pron: Rokuban-me wa Kyūpiddo, atatakaku aijōbukai kokoro o mochi, tobu sakisaki de shinsetsu to yorokobi o hiromemasu.
native: Six, Cupid, with a warm and loving heart, Cupid spreads kindness and joy wherever they fly.

en: Seventh, Donor, known for his booming thunderous voice, Donor leads the reindeer in cheerful
zh: 第七，唐納，因其洪亮的雷鳴般的聲音聞名，唐納帶領馴鹿們歡快地
ja: 七番目はドナー、轟く雷鳴のような声で知られ、トナカイたちを陽気に率います。
local: Seventh, Donor, known for his booming thunderous voice, Donor leads the reindeer in cheerful
ja_pron: Nanaban-me wa Donā, todoroku raimei no yō na koe de shirare, tonakai-tachi o yōki ni hikiimasu.
native: Seventh, Donor, known for his booming thunderous voice, Donor leads the reindeer in cheerful

en: songs.
zh: 歌唱。
ja: 歌を。
local: songs.
ja_pron: Uta o.
native: songs.

en: Eight, Vixen, as quick as lightning, Vixen adds an extra spark of magic to the team.
zh: 第八，維克森，像閃電一樣迅速，維克森為團隊增添了額外的魔法火花。
ja: 八番目はヴィクセン、稲妻のように速く、チームにさらなる魔法の輝きを加えます。
local: Eight, Vixen, as quick as lightning, Vixen adds an extra spark of magic to the team.
ja_pron: Hachiban-me wa Vikusen, inazuma no yō ni hayaku, chīmu ni saranaru mahō no kagayaki o kuwaemasu.
native: Eight, Vixen, as quick as lightning, Vixen adds an extra spark of magic to the team.

en: One Christmas Eve, a fierce blizzard covered the world in thick snow and fog, Santa worried
zh: 一個聖誕夜，猛烈的暴風雪覆蓋了世界，厚厚的雪和霧，聖誕老人擔心
ja: あるクリスマスイブ、激しい吹雪が世界を厚い雪と霧で覆い、サンタは心配しました。
local: One Christmas Eve, a fierce blizzard covered the world in thick snow and fog, Santa worried
ja_pron: Aru Kurisumasu Ibu, hageshii fubuki ga sekai o atsui yuki to kiri de ooi, Santa wa shinpai shimashita.
native: One Christmas Eve, a fierce blizzard covered the world in thick snow and fog, Santa worried

en: he wouldn't be able to deliver the gifts.
zh: 他可能無法送出禮物。
ja: 彼はプレゼントを届けられないかもしれないと心配しました。
local: he wouldn't be able to deliver the gifts.
ja_pron: Kare wa purezento o todokerarenai kamoshirenai to shinpai shimashita.
native: he wouldn't be able to deliver the gifts.

en: That's when he heard about a young reindeer with an unusual gift, a glowing red nose.
zh: 就在那時，他聽說了一隻擁有特殊天賦的年輕馴鹿，一個發光的紅鼻子。
ja: その時、彼は珍しい才能を持つ若いトナカイ、光る赤い鼻の話を聞きました。
local: That's when he heard about a young reindeer with an unusual gift, a glowing red nose.
ja_pron: Sono toki, kare wa mezurashii sainō o motsu wakai tonakai, hikaru akai hana no hanashi o kikimashita.
native: That's when he heard about a young reindeer with an unusual gift, a glowing red nose.

en: This reindeer, Rudolph, had always been shy because of his bright nose, but Santa saw
zh: 這隻馴鹿，魯道夫，因為他明亮的鼻子一直很害羞，但聖誕老人看到
ja: このトナカイ、ルドルフは明るい鼻のためにいつも恥ずかしがり屋でしたが、サンタはそれを
local: This reindeer, Rudolph, had always been shy because of his bright nose, but Santa saw
ja_pron: Kono tonakai, Rudorufu wa akarui hana no tame ni itsumo hazukashigariya deshita ga, Santa wa sore o
native: This reindeer, Rudolph, had always been shy because of his bright nose, but Santa saw

en: it as a blessing.
zh: 視為祝福。
ja: 祝福と見なしました。
local: it as a blessing.
ja_pron: Shukufuku to minashimashita.
native: it as a blessing.

en: Rudolph led the sleigh that night, lighting away through the storm.
zh: 魯道夫那晚帶領雪橇，穿越風暴照亮前路。
ja: ルドルフはその夜そりを先導し、嵐の中を照らしながら進みました。
local: Rudolph led the sleigh that night, lighting away through the storm.
ja_pron: Rudorufu wa sono yoru sori o sendō shi, arashi no naka o terashinagara susumimashita.
native: Rudolph led the sleigh that night, lighting away through the storm.

en: From that day on Rudolph became the ninth member of the team, ensuring that no Christmas
zh: 從那天起，魯道夫成為第九位隊員，確保沒有聖誕節
ja: その日からルドルフはチームの9番目のメンバーとなり、どんなクリスマスも
local: From that day on Rudolph became the ninth member of the team, ensuring that no Christmas
ja_pron: Sono hi kara Rudorufu wa chīmu no 9-banme no menbā to nari, donna Kurisumasu mo
native: From that day on Rudolph became the ninth member of the team, ensuring that no Christmas

en: delivery would ever be delayed again.
zh: 禮物配送會再也不會延遲。
ja: 配達が遅れることがないようにしました。
local: delivery would ever be delayed again.
ja_pron: Haitatsu ga okureru koto ga nai yō ni shimashita.
native: delivery would ever be delayed again.

en: Today, Santa's reindeer are more than just helpers.
zh: 如今，聖誕老人的馴鹿不僅僅是助手。
ja: 今日、サンタのトナカイは単なる助っ人以上の存在です。
local: Today, Santa's reindeer are more than just helpers.
ja_pron: Kyō, Santa no tonakai wa tannaru suketto ijō no sonzai desu.
native: Today, Santa's reindeer are more than just helpers.

en: They are symbols of teamwork, courage, and the magic of Christmas.
zh: 牠們是團隊合作、勇氣和聖誕魔法的象徵。
ja: 彼らはチームワーク、勇気、そしてクリスマスの魔法の象徴です。
local: They are symbols of teamwork, courage, and the magic of Christmas.
ja_pron: Karera wa chīmuwāku, yūki, soshite Kurisumasu no mahō no shōchō desu.
native: They are symbols of teamwork, courage, and the magic of Christmas.

en: Each one brings something unique to the team, proving that everyone has a special role
zh: 每一隻都為團隊帶來獨特的東西，證明每個人都有特別的角色
ja: それぞれがチームに独自のものをもたらし、誰もが特別な役割を持っていることを証明しています。
local: Each one brings something unique to the team, proving that everyone has a special role
ja_pron: Sorezore ga chīmu ni dokuji no mono o motarashi, dare mo ga tokubetsu na yakuwari o motte iru koto o shōmei shite imasu.
native: Each one brings something unique to the team, proving that everyone has a special role

en: to play.
zh: 可以扮演。
ja: 果たすことができるのです。
local: to play.
ja_pron: Hatasu koto ga dekiru no desu.
native: to play.

en: Whenever children look up at the starry sky on Christmas Eve, they might just catch a glimpse
zh: 每當孩子們在聖誕夜仰望星空時，他們可能會瞥見
ja: 子供たちがクリスマスイブに星空を見上げるとき、彼らはふと目にするかもしれません。
local: Whenever children look up at the starry sky on Christmas Eve, they might just catch a glimpse
ja_pron: Kodomotachi ga Kurisumasu Ibu ni hoshizora o miageru toki, karera wa futo me ni suru kamoshiremasen.
native: Whenever children look up at the starry sky on Christmas Eve, they might just catch a glimpse

en: of Santa and his nine reindeer flying by, spreading joy and love to the world.
zh: 聖誕老人和他的九隻馴鹿飛過，將歡樂和愛傳遍世界。
ja: サンタと彼の9頭のトナカイが飛んでいるのを見て、世界に喜びと愛を広めています。
local: of Santa and his nine reindeer flying by, spreading joy and love to the world.
ja_pron: Santa to kare no 9-tō no tonakai ga tonde iru no o mite, sekai ni yorokobi to ai o hiromete imasu.
native: of Santa and his nine reindeer flying by, spreading joy and love to the world.
